definition: Jason Liu is the creator of Instructor and Leading Applied AI Engineering Consultant.
details: Created the `instructor` library (built on Pydantic), popularizing structured outputs, schema validation, and systematic RAG evaluation in AI engineering. Liu Chien-sin or Jason Liu (Chinese: 劉建忻; pinyin: Liú Jiànxīn; born 8 June 1968) is a Taiwanese politician who currently serve as the secretary-general of the Examination Yuan since 2020. He was appointed as the Deputy Secretary-General to the President on 21 April 2018, and the acting Secretary-General to the President on three occasions the latest being on 2 August 2020.

explainer.lead: Jason Liu is a Taiwanese politician.
